data.name: Echoes Ashore
data.description: Echoes of the Faded crew stand watch on the beach below the Wreck. Lay four of them to rest for the salvager: 1 Wreck Salvage each, up to three runs a day.
data.successDescription: The tideline is quiet until the next tide.

objectives.description:
The tide is out. Down the beach, figures stand in the shallows where no one should be standing.

"Echoes. She sheds her crew with the water, and they keep their posts on the sand. Four tonight. Put them down and I'll pay a piece for each."
The first echo is a Deck Warden, planted in the surf with its arms folded. It hasn't noticed the ship is gone.
The Deck Warden calls a watch no one answers.
objectives.failDescription: The echo holds its post, and the surf throws you back up the sand.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes over the beach behind you.
objectives.drawDescription: The echo comes apart before either of you falls, and the tide takes the rest.

objectives.description:
It comes apart like spray. A brass fitting glints where it stood.

Further down, a Seal Charge echo crouches over a fuse that never stops burning.
The Seal Charge's fuse catches.
objectives.failDescription: The echo holds its post, and the surf throws you back up the sand.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes over the beach behind you.
objectives.drawDescription: The echo comes apart before either of you falls, and the tide takes the rest.

objectives.description:
Smoke, then nothing but a scorched rope end.

An Arsenal Keeper echo stands over a crate the tide keeps trying to take, counting charges that aren't there.
The Arsenal Keeper reaches for a charge.
objectives.failDescription: The echo holds its post, and the surf throws you back up the sand.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes over the beach behind you.
objectives.drawDescription: The echo comes apart before either of you falls, and the tide takes the rest.

objectives.description:
Wet glass spills out of the crate.

The last echo stands at the waterline with a chart in both hands: a Driftline Wayfinder, still plotting a course for a ship that fell.
The Wayfinder looks up from the chart.
objectives.failDescription: The echo holds its post, and the surf throws you back up the sand.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes over the beach behind you.
objectives.drawDescription: The echo comes apart before either of you falls, and the tide takes the rest.

objectives.description:
The beach is empty. The salvager is already sorting what washed up.

"Four. That's the tide's worth. Come back when it turns."
The echoes are gone until the next tide.
The tide drags you back up the beach to her fire. The shore will still be there.

data.name: Warm Glass
data.description: At low tide, warm glass from the Wreck surfaces in the pools on the beach. Pick four pools clean for the salvager: 1 Wreck Salvage each, up to three runs a day.

objectives.description:
The sea has pulled back further than it should. Pools steam along the sand, and something glints in every one.

"Warm glass, off her hull, still holding the light. It goes cold fast, so be quick. Four pools, a piece for each."
Pick the Warm Glass out of the first tide pool. Stay until you have all of it.
The next pool steams further down the beach.
Pick the Warm Glass out of the second tide pool.
One more pool lies past the Wreck's shadow, the water there already cooling.
Pick the Warm Glass out of the third tide pool before it cools.

The last pool is the biggest and the warmest. Something under the water is keeping it warm.

A Driftline Core Horror rises out of it, glass growing through it like coral.

nextObjectiveId.text: Drag it out of the pool

objectives.description: The Core Horror heaves itself onto the sand.
objectives.failDescription: The echo holds its post, and the surf throws you back up the sand.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes over the beach behind you.
objectives.drawDescription: The echo comes apart before either of you falls, and the tide takes the rest.

objectives.description: The pool goes still. The glass at the bottom is the warmest yet.
Pick the Warm Glass out of the last pool.

The salvager weighs the glass in her palm and nods.

"Still warm. Good. The tide will bring more."
The pools go cold behind you.
The tide drags you back up the beach to her fire. The shore will still be there.

data.name: The Tideline Count
data.description: Every tide, a Deck Warden walks the beach counting a crew that isn't there. Stop the count for the salvager: 4 Wreck Salvage, up to three runs a day.

objectives.description:
The salvager doesn't look up from her net.

"Hear that? He comes up the beach every tide, counting heads. Comes up short every time, and takes it out on whoever's standing there. Tonight that's you. I'll pay four."

A Deck Warden walks the tideline with one hand raised, touching the air where shoulders should be.

"Thirty-seven. Thirty-eight. Thirty-nine..."

He stops in front of you.
The Deck Warden calls all hands.
objectives.failDescription: The echo holds its post, and the surf throws you back up the sand.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes over the beach behind you.
objectives.drawDescription: The echo comes apart before either of you falls, and the tide takes the rest.

objectives.description:
The tideline is quiet. The salvager counts four pieces of salvage into your hand.

"He counted you before he went down. Forty. Sounded pleased about it."
The count stops until the next tide.
The count goes on without you. The salvager will still be at her fire.
